title: Chris Bledsoe's inconclusive visit to Skinwalker Ranch was not aired

tellings.quote: He did. We didn't end up airing um that content. Um

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe visited Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events, during filming there, but the footage was never shown. The ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal, tells Michels, "We didn't end up airing um that content," and the visit is described as having turned up nothing conclusive.
